name: Bloodmoon over the Azure Flow
description: A colossal crimson moon rises above the horizon of Aurelion, illuminating the land with fiery celestial glow. The ancient tree stands vigil over the Azure Flow, a calm astral waterway whose surface mirrors the Bloodmoon’s light. When the Bloodmoon appears, the Azure Flow becomes a conduit of cosmic resonance, guiding travelers toward forgotten realms.
